integrity: Exact identities and infinite-dimensional convergence are derived analytically. Finite exact checks and Monte Carlo are supplementary; priority comparison remains subject to historical review.
limitations: Only circumradius-normalized squared nearest-vertex distance for a fixed regular simplex vertex code with a volume-uniform interior point; no optimality claim for the code, no full finite-dimensional CDF, no finite-sample stability theorem, no independent historical priority certification.
title: Exact dispersion and extreme-value limit for nearest-vertex quantization of a regular simplex
